from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Applications and Summary", [
            "PDEs model everything from aerodynamics to finance.",
            "They allow prediction of complex systems.",
            "Mastering them unlocks real-world technological design."
        ])
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Aerodynamics (Car)
        car = SVGMobject("assets/car.svg") if False else RoundedRectangle(height=1.0, width=2.0, color="#50E3C2")
        air_flow = VGroup(*[Line(start=LEFT, end=RIGHT, color="#50E3C2").shift(UP*i*0.2) for i in range(-2, 3)])
        car_group = VGroup(car, air_flow)
        label_aero = Text("Aerodynamics", font_size=18, color="#50E3C2")
        
        self.place_at_grid(car_group, 'B4', scale_factor=0.6)
        label_aero.next_to(car_group, DOWN, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(car_group), Write(label_aero), self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#50E3C2"))
        self.play(air_flow.animate.shift(RIGHT*0.5).fade(0.5), run_time=2, rate_func=there_and_back)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Finance (Ticker)
        ticker = VGroup(*[Line(UP*np.sin(i), DOWN*np.sin(i), color="#F5A623") for i in range(10)])
        ticker.arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1)
        label_finance = Text("Finance", font_size=18, color="#F5A623")
        
        self.place_at_grid(ticker, 'E4', scale_factor=0.6)
        label_finance.next_to(ticker, DOWN, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(ticker), Write(label_finance), self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#F5A623"))
        self.play(ticker.animate.stretch_to_height(0.5), run_time=1, rate_func=there_and_back)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Summary
        summary_rect = Rectangle(height=2.5, width=4.0, color=WHITE).set_stroke(width=2)
        self.place_at_grid(summary_rect, 'C5', scale_factor=1.0)
        self.play(Create(summary_rect), self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE))
        self.wait(2)
